declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftTotalLinearMap
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def leftTotalLinearMap {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) : A.leftModuleTotalSpace M →ₗ[k] A.leftModuleTotalSpace N

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.rightTotalLinearMap
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def rightTotalLinearMap {M N : A.RightModule} (f : M ⟶ N) : A.rightModuleTotalSpace M →ₗ[k] A.rightModuleTotalSpace N

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftTotalLinearMap_lof
declarations.full_header: @[simp] theorem leftTotalLinearMap_lof {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) (i : ℤ) (x : (A.leftModuleEvaluation i).obj M) : A.leftTotalLinearMap f (DirectSum.lof k ℤ _ i x) = DirectSum.lof k ℤ _ i ((f.hom.app (⟨i⟩ : A.Obj)).hom x)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.rightTotalLinearMap_lof
declarations.full_header: @[simp] theorem rightTotalLinearMap_lof {M N : A.RightModule} (f : M ⟶ N) (i : ℤ) (x : (A.rightModuleEvaluation i).obj M) : A.rightTotalLinearMap f (DirectSum.lof k ℤ _ i x) = DirectSum.lof k ℤ _ i ((f.hom.app (op (⟨i⟩ : A.Obj))).hom x)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftTotalLinearMap_action
declarations.full_header: theorem leftTotalLinearMap_action {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) {i j : ℤ} (a : A.Hom i j) : (A.leftTotalLinearMap f).comp (A.leftModuleTotalAction M a) = (A.leftModuleTotalAction N a).comp (A.leftTotalLinearMap f)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.rightTotalLinearMap_action
declarations.full_header: theorem rightTotalLinearMap_action {M N : A.RightModule} (f : M ⟶ N) {i j : ℤ} (a : A.Hom i j) : (A.rightTotalLinearMap f).comp (A.rightModuleTotalAction M a) = (A.rightModuleTotalAction N a).comp (A.rightTotalLinearMap f)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftTotalLinearMap_representation
declarations.full_header: theorem leftTotalLinearMap_representation {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) (a : A.totalAlgebra) : (A.leftTotalLinearMap f).comp (A.leftTotalRepresentation M a) = (A.leftTotalRepresentation N a).comp (A.leftTotalLinearMap f)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.rightTotalLinearMap_representation
declarations.full_header: theorem rightTotalLinearMap_representation {M N : A.RightModule} (f : M ⟶ N) (a : A.totalAlgebra) : (A.rightTotalLinearMap f).comp (A.rightTotalRepresentation M a).unop = (A.rightTotalRepresentation N a).unop.comp (A.rightTotalLinearMap f)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.leftTotalModuleMap
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def leftTotalModuleMap {M N : A.LeftModule} (f : M ⟶ N) : A.leftTotalModule M ⟶ A.leftTotalModule N

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.rightTotalModuleMap
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def rightTotalModuleMap {M N : A.RightModule} (f : M ⟶ N) : A.rightTotalModule M ⟶ A.rightTotalModule N

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.foundationRightTotalAction
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def foundationRightTotalAction (M : A.FoundationRightModule Q) (x : A.FoundationAlgebra Q) : Module.End k (A.foundationRightTotalSpace Q M)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.foundationRightTotalAction_apply
declarations.full_header: theorem foundationRightTotalAction_apply (M : A.FoundationRightModule Q) (x : A.FoundationAlgebra Q) (m : A.foundationRightTotalSpace Q M) (i : Q.Vertex) : A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M x m i= ∑ j : Q.Vertex, A.foundationRightComponentAction Q M (x i j) (m j)

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.foundationRightTotalAction_add
declarations.full_header: theorem foundationRightTotalAction_add (M : A.FoundationRightModule Q) (x y : A.FoundationAlgebra Q) : A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M (x+y)= A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M x+A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M y

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.foundationRightTotalAction_smul
declarations.full_header: theorem foundationRightTotalAction_smul (M : A.FoundationRightModule Q) (c : k) (x : A.FoundationAlgebra Q) : A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M (c • x)=c • A.foundationRightTotalAction Q M x

declarations.name: ASGinzburg.ZAlgebra.foundationRightTotalRepresentation
declarations.full_header: noncomputable def foundationRightTotalRepresentation (M : A.FoundationRightModule Q) : A.FoundationAlgebra Q →ₗ[k] Module.End k (A.foundationRightTotalSpace Q M)
